messages:
Jane (Partnerships): kicking off a short thread to align on marketplace launch ops: press embargo, partner assets, staging manifest, and co-marketing kits. we need concrete deadlines.
Sam (Marketing): will own blog + landing. draft to review by 1823463600 (T-9d). need hero concepts and two CTA options.
Anita (PR): grouping press outreach. ask partners for quote + logo signoff by 1823452000 (T-12d). propose embargo 2026-10-12 08:00 PT.
Leo (Product): recommending we surface Dedicated first, with Hosted as fallback. uploading SKU/tags CSV to the shared drive.
Mike (Eng): I'll validate the marketplace manifest and add a health webhook. smoke test command: `./scripts/mp-smoke --staging --manifest mp-2029-07`
Alex (Design): can deliver two hero variants + small co-branded badge if logos/colors are in by 1823459000.
Jane (Partnerships): action list: partners -> quote/logo by 1823452000; Sam -> blog + landing draft by 1823463600; Anita -> embargoed press list by 1823467200; Mike -> manifest + smoke by 1823457600; Alex -> hero assets by 1823459000.
Sam (Marketing): landing CTAs: ["Deploy in your cloud", "Request a demo"]. leaning to "Deploy in your cloud" for marketplace tile. will add UTMs.
Anita (PR): we need partner legal OK for quote attribution. partners who miss the deadline will get a "integration coming soon" badge on the listing.
Leo (Product): SI needs a short Terraform snippet + IAM note for marketplace install. I'll draft a 5-step how-to for the listing detail page.
Mike (Eng): note: marketplace runtime requires a container entrypoint and health endpoint. sample response: `GET /marketplace-health -> 200 {"status":"ok"}`. I'll push example to repo and run smoke once assets are staged.
MarketplaceBot: staging listing created -> id: mp-2029-07, status: awaiting-assets. validation webhook pending.
Sam (Marketing): social hooks: 1-line for product + 1-line for partners needed by 1823467200. also want a 1-line partner quote for hero if available.
Jane (Partnerships): scheduling final go/no-go sync 10/05 16:00 PT. agenda: manifest validation, press approvals, hero asset signoff, embargo confirmation. calendar invite incoming.
Anita (PR): I'll prepare the embargoed release draft and share for review under comments only. please avoid thread replies in the doc to keep merge simple.
Alex (Design): pinging partner contacts for SVG logos now. will post progress here.
Mike (Eng): smoke pre-check queued. will post results in this thread within 24h.
Jane (Partnerships): thanks — flag any blockers here. if everyone hits deadlines we'll aim for marketplace live + coordinated press on embargo day.
